title: HelioHealth: support-access exception language (draft for procurement)
body:
Working draft language (HelioHealth)

Customer requirement
- EU-only serving and storage.

Proposed exception (support access)
- Redwood support personnel may be located outside the EU.
- Non-EU personnel access is limited to operational metadata and audit logs via RBAC (break-glass), time-limited, and fully audited.
- Prompts/responses are not stored as logs for the HelioHealth tenant (payload logging disabled).

Open questions
- Do we commit to monthly access report proactively or available on request?
- Confirm whether any third-party subprocessor has access to EU logs (should be no).
